mia: Spinning up Lacerta14b (int4, q4_k_m) canary. Seeing intermittent OOMs on long-doc QA. Canary: batch=8, max_new_tokens=256, prefetch=on. Kicking off perf run.

alex: Can you drop the OOM snippet and perf snapshot? node/pool?

mia: pool=canary-gpu-small. Snapshot: 
```
workload: 1.2k short QA + 250 long-docs
batch=8, max_new=256
P50=130ms P95=460ms
peak gpu mem ~33.2 GiB
OOM: cudaMalloc failed in kv_slot::grow -> attempted 48MB alloc, free 10MB
node: canary-gpu-small-07
```

ryan: Looks like unbounded KV growth during long gens. Quick mitigations: reduce batch to 4, or lower max_new_tokens to 128, or cap KV with max_kv_bytes=48MB and evict_policy=LRU_soft. Also try prefetch=false for this model to avoid concurrent allocs.

mia: Tried batch=4 + prefetch=false locally — no OOMs, but p95 spiked ~600ms and throughput -30%. Quality on short QA unchanged. Long-doc latency is main offender.

alex: For production safety, implement a router rule: if est_resp_tokens > 200 -> route to lacerta13b-int8 fallback. That keeps user experience while we tune. Add metric tag route=fallthrough so we can compare quality.

ryan: Ops knobs to test on canary: (A) max_kv_bytes=48MB, evict_policy=LRU_soft, batch=6, prefetch=false; (B) batch=8, max_new=128, prefetch=true, kv_cushion=0.12; (C) batch=6, max_new=256, kv_slot_compact=true, max_prefetch_ops=3. Run quick microbench (1k QA, 200 summarization, 100 long).

mia: I'll run A/B/C and report QA-F1 / ROUGE / p95 / OOM count. Also enable a canary alert: if OOM_rate > 0.05% then auto-roll back to lacerta13b-int8.

deploy-bot: Canary r-20260402-12 started on pool canary-gpu-small (12% nodes). Monitoring hooks live.

alex: One more: on kernel selection, set kernel_pref=local_first to improve memory locality for long contexts. Might reduce fragmentation.

mia: Running experiments now. Will push the 30m summary here. Thanks :thumbsup:
